build_systems.name: dbt (duckdb)
build_systems.notes: Project profile comes from DBT_PROFILE_NAME, default nyc_taxi_analytics.

build_systems.name: dlt
build_systems.notes: Run from ingestion/. Pipelines import vibedata.dlt.duckdb; orchestration/run_ingest.py sets the three variables it needs.

test_frameworks.name: dbt tests
test_frameworks.scope: Generic tests in _*.yml, singular tests in transformation/tests/, unit tests in models/intermediate/_unit_tests.yml.

test_frameworks.name: pytest
test_frameworks.scope: Offline unit tests for ingestion, orchestration, and the two maps.

applications.name: nyc-taxi-duckdb-demo
applications.description: NYC taxi analytics over real TLC trip records for 2024-01 to 2024-03, plus two simulated source systems (fleet operations and master data). Warehouse file: domain.duckdb at the repo root.

bronze.notes: TLC trips and zone lookup, verbatim.

tlc.description: NYC TLC yellow and green trips and the zone lookup, fetched from the public TLC site.

ops.description: Fleet operator's platform, generated from the yellow trips.

mdm.description: Master-data platform: zones, vendors, payment methods, rate plans, regimes, boroughs, points of interest, calendar, weather.

ingestion.description: dlt pipelines (one per source), their source code under sources/, resource docs under docs/, and .dlt/config.toml.

orchestration.description: Scripts that run ingestion and the dbt build, in order.

staging.description: Views: one per source table, renamed and typed. Also holds _sources.yml.

intermediate.description: Business logic and joins: conformed trips, enrichment, fare components, quality flags, status intervals, shift occupancy and economics. Unit tests in _unit_tests.yml.

core.description: Facts and conformed dimensions, plus the semantic model (_semantic.yml).

finance.description: Revenue marts. Apply the billable rule.

ops.description: Fleet-operations marts: driver scorecard, vehicle utilisation, trip quality scorecard.

macros.description: trip_natural_key (the only definition of trip_key), report window, schema naming, finance helpers.

python_tests.description: pytest tests for ingestion, orchestration and the two maps.

decisions.description: ADRs, including the standing business answers.

designs.description: Design records per model and pipeline, and the setup design for this repo.

rules.description: Operator conventions: naming, style, testing, dlt, and what goes in context, ADRs and design records.

notes_for_agents.startup: Read this file first. AGENTS.md says how to work; .agents/rules/ has the conventions.
notes_for_agents.reporting_window: report_start and report_end are dbt vars in dbt_project.yml and define the business reporting window. They are not a sampling control.
notes_for_agents.synthetic_data: ops_raw and mdm_raw are simulated. TLC trips are real. docs/data-provenance.md says which is which.
notes_for_agents.trip_key: Produced only by the trip_natural_key macro. The operator source carries natural columns, not the key.
notes_for_agents.warehouse: domain.duckdb at the repo root is ignored by git and rebuilt by orchestration/run_all.py.
notes_for_agents.dlt_environment: Pipelines need VD_DOMAIN_DATA_PLATFORM=duckdb_local, VD_DOMAIN_SECRET_STORE_KIND=local_toml and VD_EPHM_DUCKDB_LOCAL_PATH; orchestration/run_ingest.py sets them.
